css: .flow>.ft>span { display:inline-block; font-size:15.5px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.05em; color:#14532d; background:#d7efe0; border-radius:5px; padding:3px 8px; }

.fstep::before { content:""; position:absolute; left:16px; top:0; bottom:0;
      width:3px; background:#1b6b3a; z-index:1; }

.fstep::after { content:""; position:absolute; left:34px; top:50%; width:20px;
      height:2px; background:#9ec9b0; transform:translateY(-50%); z-index:1; }
